| 方案 | 优点 | 缺点 |
|---|---|---|
| Linux socket API | 原生、稳定、依赖少、通用性强 | 代码相对繁琐，异步处理麻烦 |
| boost::asio | C++ 工程友好，异步 UDP 方便，适合封装 driver | 需要理解 io_context、endpoint、socket 等概念 |

9737cd23fabc2669f25a76eed4aaa8369ca8375c.translatedText:
| Solution | Advantages | Disadvantages |
|---|---|---|
| Linux socket API | Native, stable, few dependencies, strong versatility | Code is relatively cumbersome, asynchronous handling is troublesome |
| boost::asio | C++ is engineering\-friendly, convenient for asynchronous UDP, suitable for encapsulating drivers | Requires understanding concepts such as io_context, endpoint, socket, etc\. |
| Qt Network | Integrates naturally with Qt programs, suitable for host computers | Not suitable for low\-level drivers detached from Qt |
| Python socket | Quick to get started, suitable for testing UDP packets | Not suitable as the C++ low\-level mainline |
| ROS 2 topic | Convenient for ROS 2 internal communication | Not suitable as a replacement for general UDP learning |

9776eaead9c1ef9fa2828bd890ea3b869efaa5b2.sourceText:
| 示例 | 讲了什么 | 新出现的语法 | 为什么这样写 | 注意事项 |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 示例 1 | 基本类型推导 | `auto x = 表达式` | 最简单的情况，类型由初始化值决定 | 字符串字面量推导为 `const char*` |
| 示例 2 | auto vs auto& vs const auto& | `auto&`、`const auto&` | `auto` 会丢失引用和顶层 const，要用 `auto&` 才能引用原变量 | 遍历容器元素时要注意 |
| 示例 3 | 简化复杂类型 | 迭代器、智能指针用 auto | 类型名太长时用 auto 保持可读性 | auto 不弱化类型安全，只是让编译器帮你写 |
| 示例 4 | auto 遍历时的拷贝陷阱 | 范围 for + auto/auto& | `auto` 遍历拷贝元素，`auto&` 引用元素 | 想修改原容器必须用 `auto&` |
| 示例 5 | auto 返回值 vs decltype(auto) | `auto` 函数返回、`decltype(auto)` | 函数返回引用时，普通 `auto` 会退化成值返回 | `decltype(auto)` 很强，但也要确认不会返回悬垂引用 |
9776eaead9c1ef9fa2828bd890ea3b869efaa5b2.translatedText:
| Example | What was discussed | Newly introduced syntax | Why it is written this way | Precautions |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Example 1 | Basic type deduction | `auto x = 表达式` | The simplest case: the type is determined by the initializer | String literals are deduced as `const char*` |
| Example 2 | auto vs auto& vs const auto& | `auto&`、`const auto&` | `auto` loses references and top\-level const, so `auto&` is needed to refer to the original variable | Pay attention when iterating over container elements |
| Example 3 | Simplifying complex types | Use auto for iterators and smart pointers | Use auto to keep readability when type names are too long | auto does not weaken type safety; it just lets the compiler write it for you |
| Example 4 | The copy pitfall when iterating with auto | Range for \+ auto/auto& | `auto` iterates over copied elements,`auto&` refers to elements | To modify the original container, you must use `auto&` |
| Example 5 | auto return type vs decltype(auto) | `auto` function return,`decltype(auto)` | When a function returns a reference, ordinary `auto` degrades to a value return | `decltype(auto)` is powerful, but you also need to make sure it will not return a dangling reference |

97e46d050566ec4e9c68300e465820241a560905.sourceText:
| 写法 | 含义 | 适用场景 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `[]` | 不捕获外部变量 | 只用参数或局部临时变量 |
| `[x]` | 按值捕获 `x` | 保存一份副本，适合保存回调 |
| `[&x]` | 按引用捕获 `x` | 需要修改外部变量，且能保证生命周期 |
| `[x, &y]` | 混合捕获 | 明确表达哪些拷贝、哪些引用 |
| `[=]` | 默认按值捕获用到的变量 | 小例子方便，工程中不建议滥用 |
| `[&]` | 默认按引用捕获用到的变量 | 异步或保存回调中尤其危险 |
| `[this]` | 捕获当前对象指针 | 对象必须比 lambda 活得久 |
| `[*this]` | 捕获当前对象副本 | C++17 起可用，适合避免悬空 `this` |
97e46d050566ec4e9c68300e465820241a560905.translatedText:
| Syntax | Meaning | Applicable scenario |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `[]` | No capture of external variables | Only use parameters or local temporary variables |
| `[x]` | Capture by value`x` | Saves a copy, suitable for storing callbacks |
| `[&x]` | Capture by reference`x` | Needs to modify external variables and can guarantee lifetime |
| `[x, &y]` | Mixed capture | Explicitly express which are copies and which are references |
| `[=]` | Default capture by value of used variables | Convenient for small examples, not recommended for abuse in engineering |
| `[&]` | Default capture by reference of used variables | Especially dangerous in asynchronous or stored callbacks |
| `[this]` | Capture the current object pointer | The object must live longer than the lambda |
| `[*this]` | Capture a copy of the current object | C++17 available since, suitable for avoiding dangling`this` |
